assessments.reasoning: The digest-matched GPO scan carries the IEEE 1076-1987 imprint and approval metadata. Physical pages 64–65 in §4.3.1.1 distinguish declarations with a value expression from deferred constants and explicitly require package declaration and package body completion. Section 2.6 on PDF p.40 confirms the matching identifier and conforming subtype.

challenge.method: Read the scanned pages alongside the §2.6 cross-reference. Challenge with an initialized constant, a declaration without initialization outside a package, completion in a different body, and reading the constant before elaboration.
challenge.results: An initialized ordinary constant falls outside the condition. A deferred constant is confined to the package declaration and requires its corresponding value-supplying declaration in that package's body. Section 2.6 separately limits use before elaboration. The precise claim is supported.

limitations: This is the IEEE 1076-1987 requirement. The approval year and the March 1988 publication date reflect different events.
The claim concerns language declarations. It supplies no compiler conformance or synthesis guarantee.
